description:
Presence/absence of a legume gene across the accessions of an LIS pangenome: soybean and wild soybean (32
annotations incl. Wm82, Lee, Zh13, Williams, Japanese and Chinese cultivars, G. soja W05/PI483463), Phaseolus (8,
common bean and wild relatives), Vigna (13: cowpea, adzuki bean, mungbean), Medicago (8), peanut (4), Cicer (4:
kabuli, desi, wild) and pea (3). gene: an LIS or Ensembl gene ID (GLYMA_01G000100 / Glyma.01G000100, Phvul..,
Vigun.., Medtr.., Ca1g.., Psat..) or a pangene ID. Returns which accessions carry a member (and how many copies),
which lack one, and the member IDs. Absence can be an annotation gap or divergence rather than a deletion.
Cite the LIS pangene set (pandagma, https://data.legumeinfo.org).
name: legume_pangene_presence
